messages.author: Republic Of Germany
messages.text: add nuke penalties on players after a certain amount of time from using a nuke, this will prevent players from using nukes unless needed because if you were to nuke someone than you would have a penalty, penalties  could include: market tariffs, or population lost.

messages.author: Sirius W. Frost
messages.text: Arbitrary punishments won't fix the issue. We shouldnt introduce a mechanic and outright punish people for using it
